1. `sdk/storage/azure_storage_blob/src/generated/models/pub_models.rs` — The PR directly edits an auto-generated file to change `#[serde(rename = "ETag")]` to `"Etag"`, while the PR description itself says "this issue must be fixed in the TypeSpec specification... not by modifying the generated files directly." This is self-contradictory and will be silently clobbered (or produce a conflict) on the next codegen run. Fix: don't touch the generated model at all — if the goal is only to demonstrate the bug, write the test against a local/private test-only struct or a `serde_json::Value` probe, not by actually changing generated production code.

2. `sdk/storage/azure_storage_blob/CHANGELOG.md` — Adds a "Bugs Fixed" entry claiming the etag rename is fixed, but this is a test-demonstration PR per its own description, and the real fix must land via TypeSpec. Shipping this changelog line misleads consumers into believing the bug is resolved in this release when it is an agent-authored edit to generated code that isn't the sanctioned fix path. Fix: remove the changelog entry (or clearly mark it as unresolved/tracked by #2830, not fixed).

3. `pub_models.rs` doc comment — A hand-written "MANUAL FIX" / "temporary fix" comment block was inserted into an auto-generated file. Generated files should not carry hand-authored rationale; it will be lost on regeneration and misleads future readers about the provenance/durability of the change. Fix: remove the manual comment; any rationale belongs in the PR/issue, not in generated source.

4. Scope/correctness of the rename itself — `BlobPropertiesInternal` is very likely deserialized from more than one response shape (e.g., Get Blob Properties via HTTP headers vs. List Blobs XML/JSON enumeration results). No evidence is given that all call sites use "Etag" casing; flipping the rename globally risks silently breaking other currently-working code paths that rely on "ETag". Fix: audit every deserialization path that populates this struct before asserting "Etag" is universally correct, or scope the test/fix to the specific operation where the bug was observed.

5. `src/lib.rs` test module — Tests call `serde_json::from_str` directly on `BlobPropertiesInternal`/`BlobFlatListSegment`, but the actual List Blobs REST response is XML, consumed through `typespec_client_core`'s deserialization pipeline, not raw `serde_json`. These tests may not exercise the real bug path at all (XML vs. JSON case-sensitivity/parsing can differ), so they could pass/fail independent of the actual production issue. Fix: verify and test against the actual deserialization path used by the SDK pipeline (e.g., via the crate's response-parsing utilities) rather than ad hoc `serde_json::from_str`.

6. `azure_storage_blob/Cargo.toml` — `serde_json.workspace = true` is added; confirm this is placed under `[dev-dependencies]` (it's only used in `#[cfg(test)]` code) so it isn't pulled into the shipped production dependency graph. If it's currently in `[dependencies]`, move it.

7. Test style (`src/lib.rs`) — New tests use verbose `match Ok/Err { ... println!... panic!... }` patterns instead of idiomatic `assert!`/`assert_eq!`/`.expect()`, and leave debug `println!`/emoji output in committed test code. Fix: simplify to standard Rust assertion idioms consistent with the rest of the test suite.
